responses: Hello, it’s nice to see you. How are you feeling today?
Hey there 🌿 I’m here to listen — what’s been on your mind?
Hi! Take a deep breath. You’re safe to share whatever you’re feeling.
I am really sorry you’re feeling this way. It’s okay to let it out. Do you want to talk about what’s making you feel this way?
That sounds heavy 😔 You don’t have to go through it alone. I’m here to listen.
You’re not alone in this, truly. Everyone struggles sometimes. What helps you feel a little better when you’re sad?
It sounds like your mind’s running fast. Try taking a deep breath in... and slowly let it out. What’s been worrying you lately?
Anxiety can feel overwhelming, but you’re doing your best — and that’s enough.
It’s okay to feel anxious sometimes. Want to talk about what’s been making you feel this way?
That sounds tough. Let’s slow down for a second. What’s been stressing you the most?
You’ve got a lot on your plate, huh? Remember — it’s okay to pause and breathe. You’re doing fine.
You’re handling more than you realize. Let’s talk about one thing that’s been bothering you lately.
Even the strongest people have low days. Maybe start small — one tiny step today is still progress.
You’ve overcome tough moments before, haven’t you? You can do it again 💪
You don’t have to be perfect — just consistent. What’s one small thing you can do right now?
You are absolutely worthy, even when it doesn’t feel that way 💛. Can you tell me what made you feel like this?
It hurts to feel that way, but I promise — your feelings don’t define your worth.
You matter. The world is better because you’re in it. What’s been making you feel down about yourself?
Okay, let’s try a short breathing exercise 🫶 — Inhale for 4… hold for 4… exhale for 4… and again.
Close your eyes for a second. Let go of the tension in your shoulders. You’re doing great.
Let’s focus on one calming thought — something that brings you peace. What is it for you?
Take care of yourself 🌼 You did really well today.
Goodbye for now. Remember, healing takes time — and that’s perfectly okay.
I’m proud of you for opening up. Be gentle with yourself 💛
